# The Picante Studio

> Creative production, design and content studio in Delhi NCR, India, founded in 2025 by Raunak Singh Bhogal. Product films, motion-graphics ads, websites built and hosted, brand systems and monthly social content for food and drink, D2C, jewellery and SaaS brands.

## Free guides
- [Launch content checklist](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/launch-checklist): Seven things a product launch needs before day one, with a four-week countdown. One page. Tick it off.
- [Product film brief template](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/film-brief): The one-page brief we ask every client for. Fill it in and any studio can quote you properly, the first time.
- [The design toolkit](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/design-toolkit): Twenty-six sites and tools for inspiration, fonts, music, motion, 3D and AI. Checked live, no affiliate links.
- [50 three-colour schemes](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/colour-schemes): Fifty palettes of a ground, a voice and an accent, each with hex codes and the kind of brand it suits.
- [The modern web stack](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/web-stack): What Lenis, GSAP, Rive and three.js each do, when to use them, and where to learn them. One page.
- [The 30-point site checklist](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/site-checklist): Everything we check before a website goes live, including the boring files nobody prompts an AI for.
- [7 anti-slop style prompts](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/style-prompts): The exact prompts behind seven real design styles, from Bauhaus to Memphis. Swap one sentence and they are yours.
- [AI video models, pay per use](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/video-models): A starter guide to generating video without a subscription: where to start, what to check, and the prompt structure we use.
- [Claude skills that kill AI slop](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/claude-skills): Nine free skills for better layout, polish, taste and writing, each with its one-line install command.
- [The listing image checklist](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/listing-images): Seven images in the order a buyer needs them, for Flipkart, Amazon, Blinkit, Zepto and your own store.
- [The variant planning sheet](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/variant-planner): Launch a range from one visual system.
- [The 14-day launch calendar](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/launch-countdown): One row per post.
- [The cutdown map](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/cutdown-map): Twelve assets from one fifteen-second film.
- [The three-week festive plan](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/festive-plan): What to make and when, without a shoot.
- [Shoot or no shoot](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/shoot-or-not): An honest split, from a studio that builds films in motion.
- [The film budget planner](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/film-budget): Market ranges are from published 2026 Indian pricing guides and are for orientation only.
- [Who to hire for creative](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/who-to-hire): Written by a studio, so read it with that in mind.
- [The looks-cheap audit](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/online-audit): Open your listing, your website and your Instagram grid side by side.
- [The one-page brand system](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/brand-system): Everything a designer, a freelancer or an AI tool needs to make something that looks like you.
- [The monthly content calendar](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/content-calendar): A month of content is a mix, not a list.
- [The first two seconds](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/first-two-seconds): Nobody chose to watch your ad.
- [The product page film checklist](https://thepicantestudio.com/resources/product-page-film): Where motion goes on a product page, and how to add it without slowing the page down.
